summary: FrieslandCampina is dutch dairy company, founded in 2009. Type: private company. About 17,578 employees (LinkedIn page). insights.one_liner: Dutch farmer-owned dairy cooperative; its open roles are internships and entry jobs in English, with visa mentions and IND sponsor status.

culture.text: Describes its people as open, friendly, straightforward and pragmatic, about 17,578 on LinkedIn.
Staff often come from Wageningen, Groningen, Hanze, Van Hall Larenstein and VU, studying business, economics, marketing and supply chain.
All 11 jobs are internships or entry level, in Wageningen, Amersfoort and Veghel, mainly R&D and finance.
Core values are act with respect, aim higher and succeed together.

open.text: FrieslandCampina Nederland B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
None of its 11 jobs here require Dutch and 36% mention visa or relocation.
Its jobs draw about 138 applicants each on LinkedIn on average, so expect competition.

growth.text: Over 20,000 employees (FTEs) with branches in 29 countries, owned by about 15,000 dairy farmers.
Took a majority stake in Indonesian dairy company Ultrajaya Milk.
Opened a new R&D application centre in Singapore.

worth_knowing.text: Cutting 41 jobs in Leeuwarden over the next few years.
Won a trademark case giving it sole right to the 'Chocomel yellow' colour.
